intent.raw: create a reusable development package that adds one new meta-type to the ontology, closes its design, and implements it in TypeScript, Python, and Rust
intent.objective: Execute one authority-safe meta-type lifecycle from explicit semantic intent through three independent language witnesses and bounded parity evidence.

subagent_strategy.trigger: After the TypeScript trust gate, Python and Rust have disjoint native source and adapter scopes but must join against one frozen observation contract.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Keep candidate formation, owner admission, canonical mutation, design closure, observation-contract work, and TypeScript trust-building sequential. Fan out only the independent Python and Rust lanes, then join before parity.

roles.purpose: Execute MTCI-008 against the frozen observation contract.
roles.owns: Python adapter and realization paths only.

roles.purpose: Execute MTCI-009 against the frozen observation contract.
roles.owns: Rust adapter and realization paths only.

roles.purpose: Rerun MTCI-012 read-only after all applicable receipts close.
roles.owns: Final verification receipt and residue ledger only.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: After MTCI-007 passes, approve one Python lane and one Rust lane with the exact scopes and receipt contract in this dispatch?

steps.name: Validate the Invoke package
stop_conditions: block if Design selection, Work Pack structure, dispatch validation, or Distill validation fails

steps.name: Instantiate the candidate ontology hypothesis
stop_conditions: block incomplete semantic intent, identity collision, or canonical mutation

steps.name: Run formation review and semantic admission
stop_conditions: block unless an independent human owner returns admit with discriminating evidence

steps.name: Create canonical DS-D1 assets
stop_conditions: block stable-ID reuse, non-discriminating fixtures, or baseline regression

steps.name: Create reciprocal ontology realization
stop_conditions: block projection authority inflation, positional identity inference, or graph drift

steps.name: Close the language-neutral implementation design
stop_conditions: block without total obligation accounting, planned witnesses, or G2 approval

steps.name: Freeze observation and evaluation contracts
stop_conditions: block language-specific semantic fields, missing unsupported algebra, or unpinned package homes

steps.name: Prove the TypeScript trust-building lane
stop_conditions: block when TypeScript reveals an unresolved shared-contract defect

steps.name: Implement Python and Rust lanes
steps.evidence_artifact: joined Python and Rust lane receipts
stop_conditions: block without exact user confirmation, registration, disjoint scopes, terminal receipts, or frozen digest agreement

steps.name: Recompose three-language parity
stop_conditions: block unsupported required evidence, lane disagreement, or majority vote

steps.name: Resolve the conditional runtime evidence plane
steps.evidence_artifact: runtime evidence or signed not-applicable receipt
stop_conditions: block collapsed static/runtime claims or unobserved effects

steps.name: Run independent read-only closeout
stop_conditions: block stale inputs, non-reproducible commands, incomplete lane lifecycle, or claim inflation

gates.condition: Define, Design selection, layering, split Work Pack, dispatch, and Distill validation pass.
Independent owner admits a discriminating formation model before canonical mutation.
Language-neutral design and total obligation matrix are approved before language code.
TypeScript proves the shared observation contract before Python and Rust open.
Python and Rust agents are joined and closed with schema-valid receipts against the frozen digest.
All applicable obligations agree across three lanes and runtime evidence is explicit when required.

boundaries.contract: Candidate artifacts cannot promote themselves; canonical mutation requires the independent admission receipt.
All language lanes consume the same approved design and frozen observation digests.
Passing evidence can support complete-witnessed only; it cannot release or deploy.

authority.validation: canonical validators native language tools and parity evaluator

promotion_splits.rule: No development receipt changes those authorities without a separately named owner decision.

promotion_guardrails: Candidate ontology nodes and generated projections have authority_effect none.
G1 admission does not authorize language implementation; G2 is independent.
Three-language agreement is bounded evidence, not semantic universality or production readiness.
Private DomainSpec and CAV2 prose must not be copied into public Arcanum.
